name: Body Scan with Breathing

instructions.description: Lie comfortably on your back or sit supported with your eyes softly closed if comfortable.
Take a slow breath in and out, then bring attention to one body area at a time from feet upward.
Notice areas of tension and soften them slightly during each exhale.
Continue scanning gradually until you have moved through the whole body.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use slow breathing and attentive relaxation throughout.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Focus only on the breath if full body scanning feels too complex.

commentsNotes: There is no need to change every sensation you notice.
Let the exhale help release unnecessary tension.
